data.name: Yohanan
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yoḥanan, meaning 'Yahweh is gracious'. A popular name among Christians for its biblical significance and association with John the Baptist and the Apostle John.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's grace and mercy in our lives.

in_hebrew.name: יוֹחָנָן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוֹחָנָן הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים רחם ונתן לי בן' או 'אלוהים חנן אותי בבן'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'יָהּ' (קיצור של 'יהוה') ו'חָנַן' (פירושו 'לרחם' או 'לחנן'). השם יוֹחָנָן מופיע מספר פעמים בתנ'ך, ביניהם על הנביא יוחנן המטביל ועל כמה דמויות אחרות.

in_greek.name: Ιωάννης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιωάννης είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος יוֹחָנָן, που σημαίνει 'Θεός ελεήσει και δώσει υιόν' ή 'Θεός ελεησμός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιωάννης είναι πολύ συχνό και αναφέρεται σε πολλούς οπαδούς του Χριστού, συμπεριλαμβανομένου του Ιωάννη του Βαπτιστή και του Ιωάννη του Αποστόλου.

in_latin.name: Ioannes
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ioannes derivatur ex hebraeo יוֹחָנָן, quod interpretatur 'Deus miserebitur et dabit filium' vel 'Deus misericordia sua donavit filium'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Ioannes erat usitatum et referebatur ad plures sanctos et discipulos Christi, inter quos Ioannes Baptista et Ioannes Apostolus.

in_english.name: Yohanan
in_english.meaning: God is gracious and has given a son
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yohanan originates from the Hebrew name יוֹחָנָן, meaning 'God is gracious and has given a son' or 'God has shown mercy and given a son'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'Yah' (a shortened form of 'Yahweh') and 'chanan' (meaning 'to be gracious' or 'to show mercy'). In the Bible, Yohanan appears as the name of several individuals, including John the Baptist and John the Apostle. The name has been adopted into various cultures and languages, often in the forms of John, Johann, or Ivan.

biblical_reference.note: The name Yohanan (or its Greek form, Ioannes) appears frequently in the New Testament, referring to John the Baptist, John the Apostle, and other early Christian figures.

saint_reference.note: The name Yohanan is associated with John the Baptist, a prominent figure in Christianity who baptized Jesus Christ.
